# pr-reviewer-fixer

> Three open Agent Skills for GitHub pull requests. pr-reviewer reads the diff with read-only agents and publishes one verdict (PASSED or BLOCKED) tied to a commit. pr-fixer reproduces each finding, writes a test that fails first, fixes it and posts a checklist of evidence. pr-merge-fixer merges the base branch into a conflicting branch, classifies each conflicted file and escalates only what the code does not decide. A person makes the merge decision.

Repository: https://github.com/jonyfs/pr-reviewer-fixer
Site: https://jonyfs.github.io/pr-reviewer-fixer/

- pr-merge-fixer: .agents/skills/pr-merge-fixer/SKILL.md

## Facts that are easy to get wrong
- No GitHub Actions workflow calls a model. No provider API key is used.
- The automatic reviewer never approves or requests changes on GitHub. Its verdict is a comment and a label.
- Only a CRITICAL finding blocks by default. REVIEW_BLOCK_AT=warning makes warnings block too.
- After five automatic fix cycles the agent asks a person in the session. The default hard ceiling is ten.
- The skills never merge, approve, tag or release.
